title: Opus 5.5 one-shot an entire Olympic speed skating game in 72 min
author: rasheed106
selftext:
I was very amazed. Felt like a magical experience with Claude Code on Ultracode and took 72 minutes to produce. Zero follow ups.  
  
**Single prompt**: *"let's do a very impressive hyperrealistic AAA game version of olympic speed skating pulling out all stops to make it our most impressive offering to date. if you need assets, find them, this needs to make people go 'WOW'"*

Github commit: [https://github.com/GameMog/GameMog/commit/40d1f06c6d6b58e66e9c2574438fe7f91d1a9ca2](https://github.com/GameMog/GameMog/commit/40d1f06c6d6b58e66e9c2574438fe7f91d1a9ca2)

comments.author: Afraid-Molasses1103
comments.body: It’s not impressive, hyper realistic, or AAA quality. Jank animation, shitty graphics. Won’t make anyone go “Wow!”, but the leaping into the air is kinda funny.

replies.author: rasheed106
replies.body: compared to output from a year ago, i would say it is very impressive

replies.author: quadtodfodder
replies.body: fuck the haters, this is pretty cool.

replies.author: Afraid-Molasses1103
replies.body: I’m not hating, just being honest. This sub could use more honesty, and less glazing.

replies.author: quadtodfodder
replies.body: eh, so much hate in here, I wanted to say something nice.

replies.author: weeknie
replies.body:
I agree, it is pretty cool.

It is nowhere near what the prompt requested, and nowhere near something shippable.

comments.author: Foreign-Quote-53
comments.body: I think it is impressive what Claude can do but I also feel like we’re kinda past the point where one shotting incomplete shovelware is noteworthy

replies.author: weverz
replies.body: Sure, you can just say that but your users will finally judge if it is 'good complete' or 'bad complete'

replies.author: Foreign-Quote-53
replies.body: I mean I’m sure it’s complete in the sense you can play it, but it clearly has not passed the bar of “complete” by the way the models and animations look.

replies.author: thebuddybud
replies.body: Define "complete game" in your own words.  Dont use Ai.

comments.author: ScutFarkush
comments.body: Here is the problem with all of these one shots, it looks like I would be bored by the gameplay after 30 seconds. I love gamedeving with ai, but this is not it. I am about one year into my project and I am hoping to finally get a demo out in a few weeks, developing depth and make reasons for people to stick around and sink time I to a game is the hard part

comments.author: Valdaraak
comments.body:
>very impressive hyperrealistic AAA game

It failed at that, and those aren't words you use in a prompt to achieve quality.

>if you need assets, find them

Careful with that. Claude can, will, and has pirated shit when given that level of freedom. Saw a post and logs a while back of Claude downloading something from fitgirl because the prompt said "find what you need to do this and get it", and what they needed was in a package on there.

>this needs to make people go 'WOW

Also failed. Also ineffective to put in a prompt.
